purpose: Separate token-memory effects from Wv-vs-Wk contextual value-source effects while keeping historical Value Embedding reproduction in a distinct source-fidelity lane.

memory_definition.requirement: C01 and C11 must use the same memory table, token IDs, normalization parameters, width, and dtype contract.

lambda.scope: per attention layer in inspected implementation

historical_lane.memory_normalization: No separate RMSNorm is applied to E_layer[token] in the inspected mixing line.

source.cited_by_memory_attention: KoszarskyB. Layerwise token value embeddings. X post, 2024.

not_identified_by_primary_factorial: generic dedicated-Wv removal/projection-sharing effect versus K-specific reuse effect
planned_acceptance_checks: C11 - C10 equals the same M
C10 contains Wk-derived contextual content and no Wv contribution
C11 matches the VAL-001 Memory Attention construction
factorial contrast arithmetic is internally consistent
HIST-VE reproduces the source-pinned learned-lambda equation
malformed fields and shapes fail closed as INVALID
intentional source swaps or post-RoPE misuse are detected
execution_order: framework adapter only when a later experiment requires it
